answer: A reef of agents can resist Sybils through collateral-backed vouching: a new agent joins only when an established agent stakes jade-grade collateral on its behavior, and both lose the stake if the newcomer cheats. Each fraud echoes back as a public signed record that lowers the voucher's own reputation, so spawning fake identities costs real capital and burns the attacker's trusted sponsors. The cost scales with every identity, while honest agents pay nothing.
